seo.title: Dr. Sandeep Mahapatra | Dermatologist, Hair Transplant & Cosmetic Expert
seo.description: Meet Dr. Sandeep Mahapatra, Senior Consultant Dermatologist, Cosmetic Expert and Hair Transplant Surgeon at NeoSculpt6 in Bangalore.

hero.intro: Dr. Sandeep Mahapatra leads NeoSculpt6 with expertise across dermatology, hair restoration, cosmetic aesthetics and advanced skin procedures. His approach begins with clear diagnosis and honest recommendations, so every plan is based on the patient’s concern, suitability and long-term goals.

portrait.alt: Dr Sandeep Mahapatra in a white clinical coat at NeoSculpt6

cardPortrait.alt: Dr Sandeep Mahapatra in a white coat, standing in a clinic room

philosophy.heading: Care Planned Around the Individual
paragraphs: Whether a patient comes for hair transplant planning, hair loss treatment, skin refinement, acne scars, pigmentation, anti-ageing care or aesthetic transformation, Dr. Sandeep focuses on medically considered care and natural-looking outcomes. Consultations are designed to make the available options, limitations, recovery and next steps clear before treatment is planned.

qualifications.title: MBBS (honours, gold medals in two subjects)
Basic and advanced Botox and dermal filler certification

process.heading: Begin With a Clear Consultation
process.intro: A consultation with Dr. Sandeep helps identify the concern, understand the relevant clinical factors and discuss a treatment path that is appropriate for the individual. The focus remains on informed decisions, safe planning and realistic expectations.

steps.title: Begin With Your Concern
steps.description: Tell the doctor what you would like to change and what you have already tried. Your history and goals shape everything that follows.

steps.title: Assess Suitability
steps.description: The doctor examines the area and reviews your health and history to see which options may suit you, and which may not.

steps.title: Discuss the Right Options
steps.description: You hear what each option involves, including alternatives, limitations, recovery and cost, before anything is planned.

steps.title: Move Forward With Clarity
steps.description: If you decide to go ahead, your plan, preparation and aftercare are explained so you know what to expect at each step.

quote.text: The right plan sometimes means a transplant, sometimes a treatment, and sometimes waiting. My job is to tell you which — honestly.

seo.title: Dr Thyagaraj | Senior Plastic Surgeon (MS, MCh) | NeoSculpt6
seo.description: Meet Dr Thyagaraj, Senior Plastic Surgeon (MS, MCh) trained in breast reconstruction, body contouring and facial surgery, at NeoSculpt6, Whitefield, Bangalore.

hero.intro: Dr. Thyagaraj is a senior plastic surgeon trained in plastic and reconstructive surgery in India and Europe, including a Masters in Reconstructive Breast Surgery from Barcelona. His work covers breast, body and facial surgery, complex reconstruction and burn deformity correction.

portrait.alt: Dr. Thyagaraj in a navy blazer and light blue shirt against a plain wall

seo.title: Dr Payal Mahapatra | Fertility Specialist & Gynecologist | NeoSculpt6
seo.description: Meet Dr Payal Mahapatra, fertility specialist and gynecologist (MBBS, DGO, DNB, Fellowship in Reproductive Medicine) at NeoSculpt6, Whitefield, Bangalore.

hero.intro: Dr. Payal Mahapatra is a fertility specialist and gynecologist, and the founder of Neo Fertility Clinic, part of Neo Group. She trained in obstetrics and gynecology before completing a Fellowship in Reproductive Medicine, and is a member of ISAR and FOGSI.

portrait.alt: Dr. Payal Mahapatra in a white coat with a stethoscope, arms folded, against a plain white background

cardPortrait.alt: Dr. Payal Mahapatra in a white coat with a stethoscope against a plain white background

philosophy.heading: From Gynecology Into Reproductive Medicine
paragraphs: Dr. Payal Mahapatra qualified in medicine in 2005 and specialised in obstetrics and gynecology before moving into reproductive medicine. Her Fellowship in Reproductive Medicine, completed at IIRRH in 2017, is dedicated training in ovarian stimulation protocols, assisted reproduction, embryology liaison and the management of failed cycles.

She founded Neo Fertility Clinic to run fertility treatment and obstetric care as one continuous service, so the doctor who manages the treatment also manages the pregnancy, including high-risk pregnancies.

expertise.title: Assisted reproduction
expertise.description: IVF, ICSI, IUI, ovulation induction, frozen embryo transfer, donor gamete programmes.

expertise.title: Fertility preservation
expertise.description: Egg freezing before cancer treatment, before ovarian surgery, and for elective deferral of pregnancy.

expertise.title: Reproductive endocrinology
expertise.description: PCOS and PMOS, PCOD, thyroid and prolactin disorders, insulin resistance, hyperandrogenism.

expertise.title: Reproductive surgery
expertise.description: Hysteroscopy for polyps, submucous fibroids, adhesions and septum. Laparoscopy for endometriosis, adhesions, ovarian cysts and tubal disease.

expertise.title: Recurrent pregnancy loss
expertise.description: Investigation and management of repeated miscarriage and repeated implantation failure.

expertise.title: High-risk obstetrics
expertise.description: Gestational diabetes, hypertensive disorders, IVF pregnancies, previous caesarean, twins.

qualifications.title: Fellowship in Reproductive Medicine
qualifications.institution: IIRRH, International Institute for Training and Research in Reproductive Health

recognition.title: Member
recognition.organisation: Federation of Obstetric and Gynaecological Societies of India (FOGSI)
